fact: Law N 019/2023 of 30/03/2023 inserts Article 116 ter requiring the Registrar General to establish and keep a central register of beneficial owners and verify its accuracy.
title: Law N 019/2023 of 30/03/2023 amending Law N 007/2021 of 05/02/2021 governing companies
publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda
